statement: Among the 2-colourings of 1..548 that agree with the twelve blocks B_1 outside the eleven windows (b-2, b+2] and the sites 31, 32, 517, 518, exactly 51 have 15,756 monochromatic 3-term progressions and every other one has at least 15,757. No October input.
